background: Jamie Flitner of Greybull served in the Wyoming House from 2017 to 2022, representing House District 26. The 2021–22 legislative directory said she was born July 10, 1964, in Buffalo; listed Midwest High School, Sheridan College, and the University of Wyoming; and identified her as a rancher. It also listed service as chairman of Big Horn County School District No. 3, and said she was married to her husband, Tim, and had two children.
